affinity.notes: Detached ground stones read as environmental props; no integrated mineral cage, sediment baffle, or load-bearing brace visibly constrains the flame.

anatomy.notes: The hovering taper, footless body, and loosely humanoid upper flame remain coherent and unobscured.

archetype.notes: Three long parallel firebolt trails terminate separately instead of three cinders arcing toward one shared Cinder Drift endpoint.

counterplay.notes: No fractured mineral brace or dim trail opening clearly communicates where and when to cross before rekindling.

finish.notes: The canvas is fully rendered with controlled emission and no text, UI, logo, or watermark.

framing.notes: The Wisp and all three declared cinders remain inside a complete, single-subject composition.

identity.notes: The fire-wisp family remains recognizable, but the large strongly defined body and attack scale do not preserve a candle-sized, barely shaped Wisp.

tier.notes: The body scale, definition, and extended projectile presentation drift beyond the T1 initiate form.
